text: Mostly yes. The engine has run on a fresh GitHub runner since about 19:01 UTC. It's trading Live with bids On, and its heartbeat is current. The Novig read key is accepted at 16 reads a second with its websocket up, and no runner address has been refused. The wallet shows about $141.87 cash. 49 bids are resting ($51.13), and one just filled (Over 149.5, Stetson at South Carolina, 163 contracts at 49c). The auto-bet has placed 0 orders in this first pass; it has only just restarted, so I'm not treating that as a fault yet. One thing is not fully healthy: the PropLine stream log line says 'stream off, no events yet'. I'm going to look at that next. Tell me if you see anything wrong on screen.
